name: message-scroller

frames.best_why: Frame 1 shows the titled thread from its first question through three exchanges.

tagline: A chat thread that keeps the newest reply in view with a jump pill.
summary: A scrolling message list for a conversation: user turns sit right in pale bubbles, assistant replies run left as plain text, and the view follows a reply while it streams. Scrolling up reveals a button that returns to the newest message.
appearance: A rounded dark chat card with a Trip planner header, user questions in pale rounded bubbles on the right, and assistant answers as grey left-aligned paragraphs. A muted follow-up bar and a round arrow send button sit along the bottom edge.
behaviour: New assistant text streams in and the viewport stays pinned to the bottom while it grows. Scrolling up detaches the pin and fades in a circular arrow button near the bottom, which returns to the latest message when pressed.
demo_content: A Lisbon trip-planning chat with a three-day itinerary across several questions and answers.
search_phrases: chat box that follows new messages
scroll to bottom button in chat
chat window pinned to latest reply
streaming answer that stays in view
message list with user and bot bubbles
chat with jump to newest button
use_when: A conversation receives long or streamed replies and the reader should stay at the newest text without scrolling.
avoid_when: It is only the scroll plumbing; the header, message bubbles and composer are left for you to build.
customise: Compose the provider, scroller, viewport and items as children with your own message markup; pass autoScroll and defaultScrollPosition to the provider and set the button direction.
weight_why: A scroll container with visibility observers and a small transition on one button.

a11y.note: No reduced-motion handling: the jump button still slides and scales for users who ask for less motion.

issues: The jump-to-latest button is barely visible in the frames, so the feature is easy to miss.
The scrollbar is very thin, giving little cue that more conversation sits above the view.
polish_why: Clean standard chat layout with a tidy composer; the scroll affordances barely show in the stills.
title: Message Scroller
